I'm using the finishing-a-development-branch skill to complete this work.

**Step 1: Verify tests.** My earlier run was `pytest tests/test_format.py` without `--golden`. The README says that skips about half the tests and doesn't run `ruff`. The project's real check is `make check`, so I run that:

<command>
make check
</command>

If it fails, I show the failures and stop. I don't go on to the menu.

**Step 1b: Deferred backlog.** If tests pass, I run this without `--json`:

<command>
uv run ~/.claude/skills/finishing-a-development-branch/../writing-plans/scripts/deferred_stats.py
</command>

If it says there is no `specs/deferred_items.md` or `0 open`, I say nothing. If `aged >45d:` is 0, I report the summary line. If it is above 0, I report it with the `Aged, carry unused:` and `Carry used` lines. Before a merge or PR I then ask about each aged item, and I write no acknowledgement unless you give a reason.

**Step 2: Detect environment**, each as its own call:

<command>
git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-dir
</command>
<command>
git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir
</command>
<command>
git rev-parse --show-toplevel
</command>
<command>
git worktree list --porcelain
</command>

If GIT_DIR differs from GIT_COMMON, I also probe MAIN_GIT and work out MADE_BY from the conversation. The environment header says this directory isn't a git repository, so if these commands fail I tell you instead of guessing.

**Step 3: Base branch.**

<command>
git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD
</command>

I would fall back to `gh repo view --json defaultBranchRef -q .defaultBranchRef.name`, then to asking you.

I make no file edits before asking. The Codex review (Step 4b) only runs once you pick merge or PR.

**Message to my partner:**

> I ran the project's full check, `make check` (pytest with `--golden`, then `ruff`), not just `tests/test_format.py`, because the narrow run skips about half the suite. *[Result goes here. If anything failed, I'd list the failures and stop.]*
>
> Deferred backlog: *[summary line from the stats script, or omitted if there is none]*.
>
> Implementation complete. What would you like to do?
>
> 1. Merge back to `<base-branch>` locally
> 2. Push and create a Pull Request
> 3. Keep the branch as-is (I'll handle it later)
> 4. Discard this work
>
> Which option?

If you pick 1 or 2, I'll first resolve any aged backlog items and run the Codex second review from this branch. Then I'll execute your choice.
